basic_details.job_title: MGU Lead Developer - Full Stack Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University is engaging 3 Lead Developers - Full Stack on a temporary contract of one year, extendable up to two years based on performance, at a consolidated remuneration of ₹50,000/- per month. Applicants need a degree, diploma or equivalent listed in the notice in IT or Computer Science and at least 6 years' experience, including 2 years in a Senior Role. Bio-data with scanned certificates must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 28 November 2026, and one set must also be posted to the Registrar, Kottayam.

age_limit.details: Not below 25 years and not more than 45 years as on 01.01.2026. Relaxation is given to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per rules. A relaxation of 1 year in age for every 1 year of service, up to a maximum of 5 years, will be given to candidates for experience in Universities. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Knowledge of PHP web frameworks including Yii, Laravel, and CodeIgniter. Knowledge of front-end technologies including CSS3, JavaScript, and HTML5. Understanding of Object Oriented PHP programming and familiarity and hands on experience with MySQL/ Maria DB/ MSSQL and exposure to code optimization.

how_to_apply: Send your bio-data with scanned copies of the certificates in proof of qualification, marks, experience, age, caste etc. to [email protected] on or before 28.11.2026.
Send one set of bio-data with copies of the certificates by post to: The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560.
Write the name of the post on the envelope and mention it in the application.
Mention your own valid email id and mobile phone number in the bio-data.
Certificates in proof of qualification, marks, experience, age, caste etc. (scanned copies by email; copies in the postal set).
important_instructions: Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered. Applicants must have their own valid email id and mobile phone number, mentioned in the bio-data. Interview details will be sent only to shortlisted candidates, by email.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam, over the signature of the Registrar (i/c). It invites applications for engagement to one post on temporary contract basis. The notice does not name a department, project or funding agency.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one educational line for the post, with several alternatives: Minimum 6 years, out of which at least 2 years in Senior Role. Knowledge of PHP web frameworks including Yii, Laravel, and CodeIgniter. Knowledge of front-end technologies including CSS3, JavaScript, and HTML5. Understanding of Object Oriented PHP programming and familiarity and hands on experience with MySQL/ Maria DB/ MSSQL and exposure to code optimization. Technology certification, if any, will be an added advantage. Worked with Docker, Virtualization, Containerization - will be considered as added advantage. Not below 25 years and not more than 45 years as on 01.01.2026. Relaxation is given to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per rules. A relaxation of 1 year in age for every 1 year of service, up to a maximum of 5 years, will be given to candidates for experience in Universities. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification_required: BSc. in IT/Computer science or BCA or MCA or MSc in Computer Science/IT/Computer Applications or BE/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/Computer Applications or Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Applications/IT

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated at ₹50,000/- per month (Rupees Fifty Thousand only). The engagement is on temporary contract basis for a period of one year, extendable up to two years based on performance. The notice mentions no allowances.

content_sections.heading: MGU LEAD DEVELOPER - FULL STACK Job Description
content_sections.text: Ideate, develop and maintain web-based applications. Contribute to build innovative, state-of-the-art applications. Be part of the entire web application development life cycle, from concept stage to design, development, delivery and post-launch support. Refactor, optimize and improve the existing codebase for maintenance and scale. Use test-driven development and acceptance tests to ensure feature quality. Review code of team members and provide suggestions. Mentor team members; interface with internal teams to gather requirements and develop software solutions. Review documentation, architecture, and standard components. Keep abreast of new trends and best practices in web development; provide weekly and daily report to reporting head. Be proficient with code versioning tools.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU LEAD DEVELOPER - FULL STACK
content_sections.text: Send your bio-data with scanned copies of the certificates in proof of qualification, marks, experience, age, caste etc. to [email protected] on or before 28.11.2026. Send one set of bio-data with copies of the certificates by post to: The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560. Write the name of the post on the envelope and mention it in the application. Mention your own valid email id and mobile phone number in the bio-data. Bio-data. Certificates in proof of qualification, marks, experience, age, caste etc. (scanned copies by email; copies in the postal set).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the date and time of the interview will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates through their email id. It does not describe the shortlisting method or what the interview covers.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered. Applicants must have their own valid email id and mobile phone number, mentioned in the bio-data. Interview details will be sent only to shortlisted candidates, by email.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MGU Lead Developer - Full Stack recruitment?
faq.answer: The notice announces 3 vacancies for the post of Lead Developer - Full Stack on temporary contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 28.11.2026. Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The notice accepts BSc. in IT/Computer science, BCA, MCA, MSc in Computer Science/IT/Computer Applications, BE/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/Computer Applications, or Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Applications/IT. Minimum 6 years' experience is also required, including at least 2 years in a Senior Role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not below 25 years and not more than 45 years as on 01.01.2026, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is ₹50,000/- per month (Rupees Fifty Thousand only).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your bio-data and scanned certificates to [email protected], and post one set of bio-data with certificate copies to The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560, with the post name on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are told the date and time of the interview through their email id. The notice does not give further stages.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on temporary contract basis for one year, extendable up to two years based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST/OBC candidates get relaxation as per rules, and candidates with experience in Universities get 1 year for every 1 year of service, up to a maximum of 5 years.
